shape_semantics.batch: Multiple observed swap-bearing groups or unlocks; individual financed closures require further proof.
shape_semantics.control: Named event, inclusion check, or open end-to-end user route used as a comparison.
shape_semantics.mixed: Split, hook, or cross-unlock structure with multiple economic roles.
shape_semantics.serial: Amount-linked ordered swaps with an evidenced capital currency closure; profitability reported separately.
shape_semantics.unresolved: Transaction/event record without a resolved transaction-wide flow classification.
